build_hdridataset_instance: build an HDRIDataset instance by passing kwargs to initialize the dataset with a data root directory
load_data_list_with_cache: load the HDRIDataset data list from disk using optional JSON caching for faster repeated indexing
load_data_list_no_cache: load the HDRIDataset data list by scanning subject directories and building fresh indexes without cache
get_data_info_by_index: get the data info dict for a given index including the RGB image and HDRI light intensity array
review_hdridataset_class: review the HDRIDataset class and its load_data_list and get_data_info methods for dataset integration
